title: HIFU Results Timeline: Week by Week
h1: HIFU results: what happens in the first day, month and year
desc: A week-by-week HIFU results timeline: what you see straight after, when the lift peaks, how long it lasts and how to keep results longer. By Skin & Laser Dubai.
answer: Straight after HIFU the skin can look slightly tighter, but the main lift develops over 2 to 3 months as new collagen forms. Results usually peak at around 3 months and last about a year, after which many people book a top-up.
body:
## Straight after treatment

Some people notice a subtle tightening immediately, partly from mild swelling. Redness fades within hours. Tenderness along the jaw or tingling can last a few days and is normal.

## The first three months

Focused ultrasound starts a healing response. Over the following weeks the body lays down new collagen and elastin in the treated layers, and this is what lifts the brows, defines the jaw and firms the neck. Most people see the clearest difference in photos taken at 8 to 12 weeks.

## How to make results last

- Use SPF 50 every day; sun breaks down collagen
- Keep a steady weight
- Maintain with Iced RF or laser lifting between yearly HIFU sessions
- Avoid smoking

## When to book a top-up

Because ageing continues, a yearly session keeps the effect going. Book it around the time you notice the result softening, usually 10 to 14 months after the first.
faq: Can I see HIFU results immediately?
A little, but the real lift appears over 2 to 3 months.
Why don't I see results yet?
If it is under 8 weeks, collagen is still forming. Take photos in the same light to compare.
Does HIFU need more than one session?
Usually one, with a yearly top-up.
